summary: Payroll Management Payslip Workflow fully tested - all features working correctly. Complete workflow tested: Draft → Operations Review → CEO Review → Approved → Generated. UI shows employee grid cards with payslip status badges, attendance-based calculations, earnings/deductions sections, and action buttons for each workflow stage.
seed_data_creation: Payslip for vinoth@drawlead.com for April 2026 was tested through full workflow and is now in 'generated' status
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll Management module fully functional. Payslip workflow APIs tested and working. Frontend UI verified with Playwright.

payroll_management_tab.details: Payroll Mgmt tab exists in HR Admin with employee grid cards

employee_grid_cards.details: Each card displays: Name, Designation, Current Salary, Payslip status badge (Draft/Generated/Not Created)

employee_detail_view.details: Click employee opens detail view with Salary/Payslip and Salary History tabs

attendance_summary.details: Shows Working Days (22), Present (1), Casual Leave (0), Sick Leave (0), Absent LOP (21), Holidays (0)

earnings_section.details: Shows Base Salary (₹25,000), Per Day (₹1,136.36), Days Paid (1), Earned (₹1,136.36)

deductions_section.details: Shows PF 12% (-₹3,000), Professional Tax (-₹200), LOP Deduction (-₹23,863.56), Total Deductions (-₹27,063.56)

net_salary.details: Net Salary displays correctly (₹-2,063.64 due to high LOP)

submit_for_operations_review.details: Button visible for Draft status, API works correctly

operations_review.details: API accepts review text and moves to CEO Review status

ceo_review.details: API accepts review text and moves to Approved status

generate_payslip.details: API generates payslip and moves to Generated status

month_year_filter.details: Filter changes payslip display correctly - March shows 'Not Created' for all employees

create_payslip_button.details: Button appears when no payslip exists for selected month

salary_history_tab.details: Shows Current Salary, Total Hikes, Initial Salary, Total Growth stats and salary history table

hike_conditions_badges.details: Color-coded badges for Annual Increase, Performance, 3 Month Review

api_tests.PUT /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/operations: PASS - Adds review and moves to ceo_review
api_tests.PUT /api/payroll/payslip/{id}/ceo-review: PASS - Adds review and moves to approved
